body:
Das primäre Ziel dieser App ist: man soll ein Abo abschließen! Möglichst schnell Bevor man merkt dass das Gedudel langweilig wird. Es grenzt an Erpressung, wenn direkt nach Start der Timer läuft: noch 24 Stunden, für 40 % Rabatt. Je nach Auswahl der zu begleitenden Tätigkeit ist der diffuse Rythmus schneller (Training) oder langsamer (Arbeiten) - das ist nun wahrlich keine Raketentechnik. Auch zum Lesen gibt es eine Auswahl: da habe ich aber lieber vor allem eins: totale Ruhe! Für mich erfüllt ein Musikstreamingdienst mit den richtigen Playlists besser die Motivation zu entsprechenden Tätigkeiten, wesentlich anspruchsvoller. Natürlich nicht für 17,99 im Jahr: das scheint hier das billigste Abo zu sein...
Sorry: kann den (angeblichen) Hype nicht versehen - nicht meins, gelöscht!
body_en: The main goal of this app is: you're supposed to take out a subscription! As quickly as possible, before you notice that the droning gets boring. It borders on blackmail when, right after starting, a timer is running: 24 hours left for a 40% discount. Depending on the activity chosen, the vague rhythm is faster (training) or slower (working) - that really isn't rocket science. There's also a selection for reading: but for that I'd rather have one thing above all: total silence! For me a music streaming service with the right playlists does a better job of motivating these activities, and is much more sophisticated. Of course not for 17.99 a year: that seems to be the cheapest subscription here... Sorry: I can't understand the (supposed) hype - not for me, deleted!

以上、ユーザー目線で使いやすいようなアップデートをお願いします。
body_en: The update seems to have changed the UI a lot, but the previous UI was easier to use. For some time there has been a bug where you can't receive the reward for overtime (it isn't even recorded), and I feel the update has made this bug happen even more often. Time not being recorded correctly is a fatal bug for this app, so I'd like it dealt with as a priority. Also, the UI has changed a lot and it's fine that the screen looks nicer, but I feel it has become "more steps and harder to understand". For the action after focus time, too, you used to switch straight to a break with one tap, and now having to tap many times is honestly a nuisance. I liked this app because it worked "smoothly" until now, but now that smoothness is gone and I feel its appeal has disappeared. I also couldn't figure out the feature for adjusting focus time at first, so I think the design is hard to understand. So, please make updates that are easy to use from the user's point of view.
